'''Owl Magistrate''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Glory}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Owl Magistrate}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Magistrate Scrutiny
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (16;{{Asc2|9|17}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Peck Assault
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals 4 damage x6.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Judicial Flight
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains {{BD2|Soar}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Soar
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Verdict
|Intent = Attack4, Debuff
|Effect = Deals (33;{{Asc2|9|36}}) damage. Applies 4 {{BD2|Vulnerable}}. Removes {{BD2|Soar}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Soar
|GivesToPlayer = Vulnerable
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Follows a fixed 4-move cycle: {{Int2|Owl Magistrate|Magistrate Scrutiny}}, {{Int2|Owl Magistrate|Peck Assault}}, {{Int2|Owl Magistrate|Judicial Flight}}, {{Int2|Owl Magistrate|Verdict}}, then repeats.

== Trivia ==
* During {{Int2|Owl Magistrate|Magistrate Scrutiny}}, the eyes from {{C|Seeing Red}} appear to flash over the player character.
